name: YouTube Summary with ChatGPT
summary: A simple Manifest V3 extension that shows a video's transcript on YouTube and helps you get an AI summary of it. A button copies a ready-made prompt and opens ChatGPT, where you paste it to see the summary.
audience: YouTube viewers who want a transcript or a short summary before deciding whether to watch a long video.
pros: Shows the video transcript directly on the YouTube page
Prepares the summary prompt for you and opens ChatGPT
cons: The summary step runs in ChatGPT, so you need to paste the prompt yourself
The author says the transcript fetching could stop working if YouTube changes its system
Relies on a third-party AI service
